recipes.title: Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Crispy on the edges, chewy in the center - the perfect chocolate chip cookie.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt. Set aside.
In a large bowl, beat the softened butter with both sugars until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then add vanilla extract.
Gradually mix in the flour mixture until just combined.
Fold in chocolate chips with a spatula.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto prepared baking sheets, spacing 2 inches apart.
Bake until golden brown on edges but still soft in the center.
Let cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to wire rack.

recipes.title: Fluffy Vanilla Cupcakes
recipes.description: Light, fluffy vanilla cupcakes topped with creamy buttercream frosting.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a 12-cup muffin tin with cupcake liners.
Whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt in a medium bowl.
In a large bowl, cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each. Mix in vanilla.
Alternate adding flour mixture and milk to the butter mixture, starting and ending with flour. Mix until just combined.
Divide batter evenly among cupcake liners (about 2/3 full).
Bake until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 5 minutes, then transfer to wire rack to cool completely.
For frosting: Beat butter until creamy, gradually add powdered sugar, then cream until fluffy.
Frost cooled cupcakes and decorate as desired.

recipes.title: Rustic Sourdough Bread
recipes.description: Crusty artisan sourdough with a chewy, tangy interior.

steps.text: In a large bowl, mix flour and water until no dry bits remain. Let rest (autolyse).
Add sourdough starter and salt. Mix and fold until fully incorporated.
Perform stretch and folds every 30 minutes for the first 2 hours.
Cover and let the dough rise at room temperature until doubled.
Turn dough onto lightly floured surface. Shape into a round boule.
Place seam-side up in a floured banneton or bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Preheat oven to 500°F (260°C) with Dutch oven inside for at least 45 minutes.
Carefully place dough in hot Dutch oven. Score the top with a razor blade.
Bake covered for 30 minutes, then remove lid and bake until deep golden brown.
Transfer to wire rack and let cool completely before slicing.

recipes.title: Moist Banana Bread
recipes.description: Super moist banana bread with a crispy top. The more brown spots on your bananas, the better!

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan.
In a large bowl, mash the bananas with a fork until smooth.
Stir in melted butter, sugar, beaten egg, and vanilla extract.
Sprinkle baking soda and salt over the mixture, stir to combine.
Add flour and stir until just combined. Do not overmix!
Fold in chocolate chips if using.
Pour batter into prepared loaf pan.
Bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Let cool in pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto wire rack.
Slice and serve warm or at room temperature. Enjoy!
